title: kv-cache-eviction-spillover-defrag-heuristics-v9: reduce fragmentation and paging under mixed workloads
author: Sana Patel
description: Motivation: We observed increased paging and memory fragmentation under mixed long- and short-sequence workloads after heuristics changes in v2.3. This caused elevated tail latencies and occasional OOMs on high-concurrency Dedicated pools. This PR introduces a set of complementary changes to the KV cache memory manager and eviction policy to reduce fragmentation, avoid unnecessary paging/spillover, and make eviction scheduling batch-aware. The changes are conservative by default and gated behind a runtime feature flag (kv.eviction.v9.enabled) for staged rollout. Summary of changes: 1) New eviction scoring function that combines last_access_time, token_chunk_size, fragmentation_penalty (per-chunk fragmentation estimate), and a coldness multiplier. 2) Background defragmentation scheduler that opportunistically consolidates adjacent free chunks during low-traffic windows; defrag work is throttled and bounded by a max_cpu_pct and max_gpu_mem_lock config. 3) Spillover hysteresis: raise and lower thresholds to avoid oscillation between in-memory and spilled-to-disk states; introduce a fast-path for small hot chunks to avoid paging them out. 4) Batching-aware eviction: when continuous batching predicts upcoming reuse patterns, prefer evicting large cold chunks that are unlikely to be needed for active batch shapes. 5) Metrics and tracing: add kv.cache.fragmentation_ratio, kv.cache.spillover_ops, kv.cache.defrag_jobs, and sampling traces for eviction decision paths. 6) Tests and perf: unit tests for scoring+defrag, integration run on perf-canary with representative workloads, and additional regression tests to exercise hysteresis thresholds. Rollout plan: enable behind kv.eviction.v9.enabled=false by default; enable in perf-canary for 48h, then ramp to 10% Dedicated, then full rollout over 7 days if no regressions. Backout: feature flag and automatic fallback to previous scoring function if kv.cache.recent_ooms > 0 for 5m. See docs/ops/kv-eviction.md for operator controls.
commit_summary: Initial refactor of eviction scoring into runtime/kv_cache/eviction_score.py
Add defrag scheduler and bounded worker pool (runtime/kv_cache/defrag_scheduler.py)
Implement spillover hysteresis and fast-path for hot small chunks
Integrate batching hints into eviction decision path (serving/scheduler/batching.py)
Unit and integration tests + perf-canary config
review_comments: Evan Zhou: Can you explain how fragmentation_penalty is calculated? We saw a regression in small-chunk throughput in local tests.

Sana Patel: fragmentation_penalty is a 0..1 value composed of two heuristics: externally observed chunk sparsity (holes per chunk) and internal compaction_score estimated from sub-chunk allocation table. I added comments in eviction_score.py and a unit test that covers boundary cases.
Maria Gomez: Defrag scheduler looks good but please ensure it cannot lock GPU memory for >5s. Also add a gauge for defrag_worker_count.
Sana Patel: added max_gpu_mem_lock_ms config and released defrag_worker_count metric. Updated docs with operator limits.
Ravi Kannan: CI flaked on perf canary the first run (timeout on long-short-mix), rerun passed. Approving for canary.
Evan Zhou: Approved after addressing fragmentation and adding the hysteresis unit tests. Recommend squash merge and short rollout window.
release_notes:
- Improve KV cache eviction scoring to reduce memory fragmentation and paging under mixed workloads.
- Add background defragmentation scheduler with operator controls.
- Introduce spillover hysteresis to prevent oscillation between in-memory and disk spillover.
- Batching-aware eviction reduces churn for continuous-batching serving patterns.
- New metrics: kv.cache.fragmentation_ratio, kv.cache.spillover_ops, kv.cache.defrag_jobs.
notes_for_ops: Default disabled via kv.eviction.v9.enabled=false. To enable in a controlled rollout: 1) enable in perf-canary using perf-canary config, 2) monitor kv.cache.recent_ooms and kv.cache.fragmentation_ratio, 3) ramp to 10% Dedicated, then to 100% if stable. Backout: set kv.eviction.v9.enabled=false or adjust kv.eviction.hysteresis thresholds. Operator knobs and thresholds documented in docs/ops/kv-eviction.md.
